name: 46392 · Wheatfield, IN
findings: ZIP 46392 (Wheatfield) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46392 (Wheatfield) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 46392 (Wheatfield) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.
